What’s inside your Welcome Book?

A little local knowledge. All the practical details.
Everything for a relaxed and enjoyable stay.

Welcome
A warm introduction to the property.
Your Stay
Wi-Fi, facilities, appliances, house rules, parking, check-in and all the practical details.
Eat & Drink
Local restaurants, pubs, cafés, takeaways and your own recommendations.
Explore
Attractions, walks, activities, days out and useful places nearby.
Getting Around
Transport, taxis, stations, parking and useful travel information.
Need Help?
Host details, useful contacts, emergency information and FAQs.
Checking Out
Departure information and a simple checkout guide.

A mobile-first guide with separate sections, simple navigation and useful actions: open in Maps, visit a website or click to call.

Digital Welcome Book
Your mobile-first interactive guide, accessed through your property’s QR code.

A professionally presented PDF version, yours to keep, email or arrange your own printing.
